name: x86-64 AVX2 (256-bit)
description: Doubled throughput over SSE. Processes 32 input bytes (24 output) per iteration. Lane-crossing permutes needed for output compaction.

key_instructions.purpose: In-lane byte shuffle for LUT lookup and byte rearrangement.
key_instructions.note: Ice Lake adds p1 as second shuffle port, doubling throughput

key_instructions.purpose: First packing stage: merge 6-bit pairs into 12-bit words.
Second packing stage: merge 12-bit pairs into 24-bit dwords.
Cross-lane quadword permutation for output byte compaction.

base64_applicability: The sweet spot for broad hardware compatibility. 8 groups per iteration. Mula/Lemire report ~7x speedup over scalar. Main limitation: VPSHUFB only shuffles within 128-bit lanes, requiring VPERMQ for cross-lane output compaction. The lookup phase needs 3 VPSHUFB + comparisons (~12 instructions). Pipeline: load -> 3x vpshufb (lookup/validate) -> vpmaddubsw -> vpmaddwd -> vpshufb (compact within lanes) -> vpermq (cross-lane fix) -> store.
